import collections

class Issue(int number, string type, string priority, string title, string state)
    assignee := "-"
    reviewer := "-"
    estimate := -1
    sprint := "-"
    comments := 0
    blocks := distinct<int>()
    blockers := distinct<int>()
    duplicate := -1
    duplicates := distinct<int>()
    string[] history := []

class Sprint(string name)
    phase := "PLANNED"
    start := 0
    end := 0
    velocity := 0
    records := map<int, int>()

class Tracker()
    day := 1
    users := distinct<string>()
    issues := map<int, Issue>()
    sprints := map<string, Sprint>()

class Condition(field := "", operation := "", value := "", number := -1)

bool query_expression(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens, const map<int, Condition> conditions, int &position, const Issue issue);
bool query_factor(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens, const map<int, Condition> conditions, int &position, const Issue issue);

bool one_of(string choices, string value)
    for choice := choices.split(" ")[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

string[] workflow(string type)
    if type == "BUG"
        return "OPEN TRIAGED IN_PROGRESS REVIEW RESOLVED CLOSED REOPENED".split(" ")
    if type == "TASK"
        return "OPEN IN_PROGRESS DONE".split(" ")
    return "BACKLOG READY IN_PROGRESS REVIEW DONE".split(" ")

bool transition(string type, string from, string target)
    pairs := if type == "BUG" then "OPEN:TRIAGED TRIAGED:IN_PROGRESS IN_PROGRESS:REVIEW REVIEW:IN_PROGRESS REVIEW:RESOLVED RESOLVED:CLOSED RESOLVED:REOPENED CLOSED:REOPENED REOPENED:IN_PROGRESS" elif type == "TASK" then "OPEN:IN_PROGRESS IN_PROGRESS:OPEN IN_PROGRESS:DONE" else "BACKLOG:READY READY:BACKLOG READY:IN_PROGRESS IN_PROGRESS:REVIEW REVIEW:IN_PROGRESS REVIEW:DONE"
    return one_of(pairs, from + ":" + target)

bool done(const Issue issue)
    return one_of("RESOLVED CLOSED DONE", issue.state)

int points(const Issue issue)
    return if issue.estimate < 0 then 0 else issue.estimate

int priority_level(string priority)
    priorities := "LOW MEDIUM HIGH CRITICAL".split(" ")
    for: index < #priorities
        if priorities[index] == priority
            return int(index)
    return -1

string optional_number(int number)
    return if number < 0 then "-" else string(number)

Issue | error issue_at(const Tracker tracker, int number)
    match tracker.issues.get(number)
        Issue found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown issue")

Sprint | error sprint_at(const Tracker tracker, string name)
    match tracker.sprints.get(name)
        Sprint found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown sprint")

void | error require_user(const Tracker tracker, string name)
    if name != "-" and not tracker.users.has(name)
        return error("unknown user")
    return void

int[] unfinished(const Tracker tracker, const Issue issue)
    int[] result := []
    for number := issue.blockers.sorted()[]
        blocker := issue_at(tracker, number)
        if not done(blocker)
            result = result.append(number)
    return result

bool blocked(const Tracker tracker, const Issue issue)
    return not done(issue) and #unfinished(tracker, issue) > 0

int wip(const Tracker tracker, string user)
    count := 0
    for issue := tracker.issues.values()[]
        if issue.assignee == user and issue.state == "IN_PROGRESS"
            count += 1
    return count

string active_sprint(const Tracker tracker)
    for sprint := tracker.sprints.values()[]
        if sprint.phase == "ACTIVE"
            return sprint.name
    return "-"

int[] members(const Tracker tracker, string name)
    int[] result := []
    for number := tracker.issues.keys().sorted()[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        if issue.sprint == name
            result = result.append(number)
    return result

int remaining(const Tracker tracker, string name)
    result := 0
    for number := members(tracker, name)[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        if not done(issue)
            result += points(issue)
    return result

string summary(const Tracker tracker, string name)
    numbers := members(tracker, name)
    total := 0
    for number := numbers[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        total += points(issue)
    return "issues {#numbers} points {total}"

void record(Tracker &tracker, int number, string content)
    issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
    issue.history = issue.history.append("day {tracker.day} " + content)
    .tracker.issues.set(number, issue)

void notify(const Tracker tracker, const map<int, bool> before, string[] &lines)
    for number := before.keys().sorted()[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        after := blocked(tracker, issue)
        match before.get(number)
            bool previous
                if after != previous
                    lines = lines.append((if after then "BLOCKED " else "UNBLOCKED ") + string(number))
            none
                void

void change_state(Tracker &tracker, int number, string target, string[] &lines)
    issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
    map<int, bool> before
    for affected := issue.blocks.values()[]
        dependent := issue_at(tracker, affected)
        .before.set(affected, blocked(tracker, dependent))
    lines = lines.append("MOVE {number} {issue.state} {target}")
    content := "MOVE {issue.state} {target}"
    issue.state = target
    .tracker.issues.set(number, issue)
    record(&tracker, number, content)
    notify(tracker, before, &lines)

bool reaches(const Tracker tracker, int start, int goal)
    pending := [start]
    distinct<int> seen
    nat head := 0
    while head < #pending
        number := pending[head]
        head += 1
        if number == goal
            return true
        if seen.has(number)
            continue
        .seen.add(number)
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        pending = pending.concat(issue.blocks.values())
    return false

string lowercase(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        match "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".find(character)
            nat position
                result += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[position]
            none
                result += character
    return result

bool numeric_text(string text)
    if not (1 <= #text <= 6)
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

Condition | error condition(const Tracker tracker, string token)
    end := 0
    while end < int(#token) and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(token[end])
        end += 1
    field := token[0:<end]
    rest := token[end:]
    operation := ""
    for candidate := [">=", "<=", "!=", "=", "<", ">", "~"][]
        if rest.starts_with(candidate)
            operation = candidate
            break
    value := rest[#operation:]
    if field == "" or operation == "" or value == ""
        return error("syntax near " + token)
    if not one_of("id type status priority assignee reviewer estimate sprint comments blocked done title", field)
        return error("unknown field " + field)
    equality := operation == "=" or operation == "!="
    ordered := one_of("= != < <= > >=", operation)
    if (field == "title" and operation != "~") or (one_of("id priority estimate comments", field) and not ordered) or (not one_of("title id priority estimate comments", field) and not equality)
        return error("bad operator " + token)
    result := Condition(field, operation, value)
    if value == "-" and one_of("assignee reviewer estimate sprint", field) and equality
        return result
    if one_of("id estimate comments", field) and numeric_text(value)
        result.number = int(value)
        return result
    if field == "priority" and priority_level(value) >= 0
        result.number = priority_level(value)
        return result
    if (field == "type" and one_of("BUG TASK STORY", value)) or (field == "status" and one_of("OPEN TRIAGED IN_PROGRESS REVIEW RESOLVED CLOSED REOPENED DONE BACKLOG READY", value)) or (one_of("assignee reviewer", field) and tracker.users.has(value)) or (field == "sprint" and tracker.sprints.has(value)) or (one_of("blocked done", field) and one_of("yes no", value))
        return result
    if field == "title"
        result.value = lowercase(value)
        return result
    return error("bad value " + token)

string[] query_tokens(string text)
    string[] tokens := []
    current := ""
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        if character == " " or character == "(" or character == ")"
            if current != ""
                tokens = tokens.append(current)
                current = ""
            if character != " "
                tokens = tokens.append(character)
        else
            current += character
    if current != ""
        tokens = tokens.append(current)
    return tokens

map<int, Condition> | error check_query(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens)
    map<int, Condition> result
    operand := true
    depth := 0
    for: index < #tokens
        token := tokens[index]
        if operand
            if token == "("
                depth += 1
            elif one_of("AND OR )", token)
                return error("syntax near " + token)
            elif token != "NOT"
                parsed := try condition(tracker, token)
                .result.set(int(index), parsed)
                operand = false
        elif token == "AND" or token == "OR"
            operand = true
        elif token == ")" and depth > 0
            depth -= 1
        else
            return error("syntax near " + token)
    if operand or depth != 0
        return error("syntax at end")
    return result

bool compare_number(int actual, string operation, int expected)
    if operation == "="
        return actual == expected
    if operation == "!="
        return actual != expected
    if actual < 0
        return false
    return if operation == "<" then actual < expected elif operation == "<=" then actual <= expected elif operation == ">" then actual > expected else actual >= expected

bool matches(const Tracker tracker, const Issue issue, const Condition filter)
    field := filter.field
    if one_of("id priority estimate comments", field)
        actual := if field == "id" then issue.number elif field == "priority" then priority_level(issue.priority) elif field == "estimate" then issue.estimate else issue.comments
        return compare_number(actual, filter.operation, filter.number)
    actual := if field == "type" then issue.type elif field == "status" then issue.state elif field == "assignee" then issue.assignee elif field == "reviewer" then issue.reviewer elif field == "sprint" then issue.sprint elif field == "blocked" then (if blocked(tracker, issue) then "yes" else "no") elif field == "done" then (if done(issue) then "yes" else "no") else lowercase(issue.title)
    if filter.operation == "~"
        return actual.contains(filter.value)
    return if filter.operation == "=" then actual == filter.value else actual != filter.value

bool query_factor(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens, const map<int, Condition> conditions, int &position, const Issue issue)
    token := tokens[position]
    position += 1
    if token == "NOT"
        return not query_factor(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
    if token == "("
        result := query_expression(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
        position += 1
        return result
    match conditions.get(position - 1)
        Condition filter
            return matches(tracker, issue, filter)
        none
            return false

bool query_term(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens, const map<int, Condition> conditions, int &position, const Issue issue)
    result := query_factor(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
    while position < int(#tokens) and tokens[position] == "AND"
        position += 1
        right := query_factor(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
        result = result and right
    return result

bool query_expression(const Tracker tracker, const string[] tokens, const map<int, Condition> conditions, int &position, const Issue issue)
    result := query_term(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
    while position < int(#tokens) and tokens[position] == "OR"
        position += 1
        right := query_term(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
        result = result or right
    return result

string number_list(const int[] numbers)
    result := [for number := numbers.sorted()[] then string(number)]
    return if #result == 0 then "-" else result.join(",")

string | error display_command(const Tracker tracker, const string[] words)
    command := words[0]
    string[] lines := []
    if command == "QUERY"
        tokens := query_tokens(words[1:].join(" "))
        conditions := try check_query(tracker, tokens)
        for: 0 <= rank < 4
            for number := tracker.issues.keys().sorted()[]
                issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
                position := 0
                if priority_level(issue.priority) == 3 - rank and query_expression(tracker, tokens, conditions, &position, issue)
                    lines = lines.append("{number} {issue.type} {issue.priority} {issue.state} {issue.assignee} " + optional_number(issue.estimate) + " " + issue.title)
        return ["QUERY {#lines}"].concat(lines).join(NL)
    if command == "BOARD"
        lines = ["BOARD"]
        finished := 0
        for type := ["BUG", "TASK", "STORY"][]
            line := type
            for state := workflow(type)[]
                count := 0
                for issue := tracker.issues.values()[]
                    if issue.type == type and issue.state == state
                        count += 1
                line += " {state} {count}"
            lines = lines.append(line)
        for issue := tracker.issues.values()[]
            if done(issue)
                finished += 1
        lines = lines.append("TOTAL {tracker.issues.size()} open {int(tracker.issues.size()) - finished} done {finished}")
        return lines.join(NL)
    if command == "WORKLOAD"
        lines = ["WORKLOAD {tracker.users.size()}"]
        for user := tracker.users.sorted()[]
            assigned := 0
            progressing := 0
            review := 0
            reviewing := 0
            total := 0
            for issue := tracker.issues.values()[]
                if issue.assignee == user and not done(issue)
                    assigned += 1
                    total += points(issue)
                    if issue.state == "IN_PROGRESS"
                        progressing += 1
                    if issue.state == "REVIEW"
                        review += 1
                if issue.reviewer == user and issue.state == "REVIEW"
                    reviewing += 1
            lines = lines.append("{user} assigned {assigned} in_progress {progressing} review {review} reviewing {reviewing} points {total}")
        return lines.join(NL)
    if command == "SPRINTS"
        lines = ["SPRINTS {tracker.sprints.size()}"]
        for sprint := tracker.sprints.values()[]
            line := "{sprint.name} {sprint.phase}"
            if sprint.phase == "PLANNED"
                line += " " + summary(tracker, sprint.name)
            elif sprint.phase == "ACTIVE"
                line += " start {sprint.start} " + summary(tracker, sprint.name) + " remaining {remaining(tracker, sprint.name)}"
            else
                line += " start {sprint.start} end {sprint.end} velocity {sprint.velocity}"
            lines = lines.append(line)
        return lines.join(NL)
    if command == "BURNDOWN"
        sprint := try sprint_at(tracker, words[1])
        if sprint.phase == "PLANNED"
            return error("sprint not started")
        last := if sprint.phase == "ACTIVE" then tracker.day else sprint.end
        lines = ["BURNDOWN {sprint.name} {sprint.phase} days {last - sprint.start + 1}"]
        value := 0
        for: sprint.start <= day <= last
            match sprint.records.get(day)
                int recorded
                    value = recorded
                none
                    void
            lines = lines.append("day {day} {value}")
        return lines.join(NL)
    number := int(words[1])
    issue := try issue_at(tracker, number)
    if command == "HISTORY"
        return ["HISTORY {number} {#issue.history}"].concat(issue.history).join(NL)
    return [
        "ISSUE {number} {issue.type} {issue.priority} {issue.state} blocked " + (if blocked(tracker, issue) then "yes" else "no"),
        "TITLE " + issue.title,
        "PEOPLE assignee {issue.assignee} reviewer {issue.reviewer}",
        "PLAN estimate " + optional_number(issue.estimate) + " sprint {issue.sprint} comments {issue.comments}",
        "LINKS blocks " + number_list(issue.blocks.values()) + " blocked_by " + number_list(issue.blockers.values()) + " duplicate_of " + optional_number(issue.duplicate) + " duplicated_by " + number_list(issue.duplicates.values()),
    ].join(NL)

string | error sprint_command(Tracker &tracker, const string[] words)
    action := words[1]
    name := words[2]
    if action == "NEW"
        if tracker.sprints.has(name)
            return error("sprint exists")
        .tracker.sprints.set(name, Sprint(name))
        return "SPRINT NEW " + name
    sprint := try sprint_at(tracker, name)
    if action == "ADD" or action == "REMOVE"
        number := int(words[3])
        issue := try issue_at(tracker, number)
        if sprint.phase == "ENDED"
            return error("sprint ended")
        if action == "ADD"
            if done(issue)
                return error("issue done")
            if issue.sprint != "-"
                previous := sprint_at(tracker, issue.sprint)
                if previous.phase != "ENDED"
                    return error("in sprint " + issue.sprint)
            if issue.state == "BACKLOG"
                return error("not ready")
            issue.sprint = name
        else
            if issue.sprint != name
                return error("not in sprint")
            if done(issue)
                return error("issue done")
            issue.sprint = "-"
        .tracker.issues.set(number, issue)
        record(&tracker, number, "SPRINT {action} {name}")
        return "SPRINT {action} {name} {number} " + summary(tracker, name)
    if action == "START"
        if sprint.phase != "PLANNED"
            return error("sprint not planned")
        active := active_sprint(tracker)
        if active != "-"
            return error("sprint active " + active)
        if #members(tracker, name) == 0
            return error("sprint empty")
        sprint.phase = "ACTIVE"
        sprint.start = tracker.day
        .sprint.records.set(tracker.day, remaining(tracker, name))
        .tracker.sprints.set(name, sprint)
        return "SPRINT START {name} day {tracker.day} " + summary(tracker, name) + " remaining {remaining(tracker, name)}"
    if sprint.phase != "ACTIVE"
        return error("sprint not active")
    .sprint.records.set(tracker.day, remaining(tracker, name))
    finished := 0
    int[] returned := []
    for number := members(tracker, name)[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        if done(issue)
            finished += 1
            sprint.velocity += points(issue)
        else
            returned = returned.append(number)
    sprint.phase = "ENDED"
    sprint.end = tracker.day
    .tracker.sprints.set(name, sprint)
    lines := ["SPRINT END {name} day {tracker.day} velocity {sprint.velocity} done {finished} returned {#returned}"]
    for number := returned[]
        issue := issue_at(tracker, number)
        issue.sprint = "-"
        .tracker.issues.set(number, issue)
        record(&tracker, number, "SPRINT RETURN " + name)
        lines = lines.append("RETURNED {number}")
    return lines.join(NL)

string | error execute(Tracker &tracker, const string[] words)
    command := words[0]
    if one_of("QUERY SHOW HISTORY BOARD WORKLOAD SPRINTS BURNDOWN", command)
        return try display_command(tracker, words)
    if command == "DAY"
        day := int(words[1])
        if day < tracker.day
            return error("day backwards")
        tracker.day = day
        return "DAY {day}"
    if command == "USER"
        if tracker.users.has(words[1])
            return error("user exists")
        .tracker.users.add(words[1])
        return "USER " + words[1]
    if command == "SPRINT"
        return try sprint_command(&tracker, words)
    number := int(words[1])
    if command == "CREATE"
        if tracker.issues.has(number)
            return error("issue exists")
        if not one_of("BUG TASK STORY", words[2])
            return error("bad type")
        if priority_level(words[3]) < 0
            return error("bad priority")
        state := workflow(words[2])[0]
        .tracker.issues.set(number, Issue(number, words[2], words[3], words[4:].join(" "), state))
        record(&tracker, number, "CREATE {words[2]} {words[3]}")
        return "CREATE {number} {words[2]} {words[3]} {state}"
    if command == "LINK" or command == "UNLINK"
        relation := words[2]
        if (command == "UNLINK" and relation != "BLOCKS") or (command == "LINK" and not one_of("BLOCKS DUPLICATES", relation))
            return error("bad link")
        source := try issue_at(tracker, number)
        target_number := int(words[3])
        target := try issue_at(tracker, target_number)
        if command == "LINK" and number == target_number
            return error("self link")
        map<int, bool> before
        .before.set(target_number, blocked(tracker, target))
        if command == "UNLINK"
            if not source.blocks.has(target_number)
                return error("no link")
            .source.blocks.remove(target_number)
            .target.blockers.remove(number)
        elif relation == "BLOCKS"
            if source.blocks.has(target_number)
                return error("link exists")
            if reaches(tracker, target_number, number)
                return error("cycle")
            if done(target)
                return error("issue done")
            .source.blocks.add(target_number)
            .target.blockers.add(number)
        else
            if source.type != target.type
                return error("type mismatch")
            if done(source)
                return error("issue done")
            if target.duplicate >= 0
                return error("target is duplicate")
            source.duplicate = target_number
            .target.duplicates.add(number)
        .tracker.issues.set(number, source)
        .tracker.issues.set(target_number, target)
        record(&tracker, number, "{command} {relation} {target_number}")
        record(&tracker, target_number, "{command} " + (if relation == "BLOCKS" then "BLOCKED_BY" else "DUPLICATED_BY") + " {number}")
        lines := ["{command} {number} {relation} {target_number}"]
        if relation == "BLOCKS"
            notify(tracker, before, &lines)
        else
            change_state(&tracker, number, if source.type == "BUG" then "CLOSED" else "DONE", &lines)
            updated := issue_at(tracker, number)
            if updated.sprint != "-"
                sprint := sprint_at(tracker, updated.sprint)
                if sprint.phase != "ENDED"
                    previous := updated.sprint
                    updated.sprint = "-"
                    .tracker.issues.set(number, updated)
                    record(&tracker, number, "SPRINT REMOVE " + previous)
        return lines.join(NL)
    issue := try issue_at(tracker, number)
    content := ""
    output := ""
    if command == "COMMENT"
        try require_user(tracker, words[2])
        issue.comments += 1
        content = "COMMENT " + words[2:].join(" ")
        output = "COMMENT {number} {issue.comments}"
    elif command == "PRIORITY"
        if priority_level(words[2]) < 0
            return error("bad priority")
        if done(issue)
            return error("issue done")
        if issue.priority == words[2]
            return error("no change")
        content = "PRIORITY {issue.priority} {words[2]}"
        output = "PRIORITY {number} {issue.priority} {words[2]}"
        issue.priority = words[2]
    elif command == "ASSIGN" or command == "REVIEWER"
        user := words[2]
        try require_user(tracker, user)
        if done(issue)
            return error("issue done")
        assign := command == "ASSIGN"
        previous := if assign then issue.assignee else issue.reviewer
        if previous == user
            return error("no change")
        if assign
            if user == "-" and one_of("IN_PROGRESS REVIEW", issue.state)
                return error("assignee required")
            if issue.state == "IN_PROGRESS" and wip(tracker, user) >= 3
                return error("wip limit " + user)
            if issue.state == "REVIEW" and user == issue.reviewer
                return error("reviewer is assignee")
            issue.assignee = user
        else
            if user == "-" and issue.state == "REVIEW"
                return error("reviewer required")
            if issue.state == "REVIEW" and user == issue.assignee
                return error("reviewer is assignee")
            issue.reviewer = user
        content = "{command} {user}"
        output = "{command} {number} {user}"
    elif command == "ESTIMATE"
        estimate := int(words[2])
        if not one_of("0 1 2 3 5 8 13 21", words[2])
            return error("bad estimate")
        if done(issue)
            return error("issue done")
        if issue.estimate == estimate
            return error("no change")
        previous := optional_number(issue.estimate)
        content = "ESTIMATE {previous} {estimate}"
        output = "ESTIMATE {number} {previous} {estimate}"
        issue.estimate = estimate
    else
        target := words[2]
        if issue.duplicate >= 0
            return error("duplicate of {issue.duplicate}")
        if not one_of(workflow(issue.type).join(" "), target)
            return error("bad state")
        if not transition(issue.type, issue.state, target)
            return error("cannot move {issue.state} to {target}")
        if target == "IN_PROGRESS"
            active := active_sprint(tracker)
            if issue.type == "STORY" and (active == "-" or issue.sprint != active)
                return error("not in active sprint")
            if issue.assignee == "-"
                return error("no assignee")
            if wip(tracker, issue.assignee) >= 3
                return error("wip limit " + issue.assignee)
        if target == "REVIEW"
            if issue.reviewer == "-"
                return error("no reviewer")
            if issue.reviewer == issue.assignee
                return error("reviewer is assignee")
        if target == "DONE" or target == "RESOLVED"
            blockers := unfinished(tracker, issue)
            if #blockers > 0
                return error("blocked by {blockers[0]}")
        if target == "READY" and issue.estimate < 0
            return error("no estimate")
        string[] lines := []
        change_state(&tracker, number, target, &lines)
        return lines.join(NL)
    .tracker.issues.set(number, issue)
    record(&tracker, number, content)
    return output
